title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease: First Installment of a Lease-End Installment Plan
content:
**Lease-end billing clause — the first installment, Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**Clause.** The first installment is the plan balance divided by the plan's number of installments, 2, plus the plan setup fee of $35, rounded to the nearest cent with a half cent rounded up (0.0001 cent is added before rounding so that an amount lying exactly on a half cent rounds up).

**The plan balance.** The plan balance is the end-of-term charges billed for the turn-in less the security deposit applied and less every end-of-term payment posted; a waiver posted on any of those charges is not taken off the plan balance at enrollment and is credited to the plan's last installments instead.

**Leases the plan is figured for.** The end-of-term invoice falls due on its mailing date plus the end-of-term payment period of 30 calendar days. The plan is open while that due date has not yet come or passed no more than 30 days earlier (the enrollment window), the days since the due date counted from the day after the due date through today, and while no end-of-term payment has posted since the invoice was mailed.

| Invoice mailed (hypothetical) | Due date | Today | Days since the due date | Open to the plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| March 1 | March 31 | March 20 | 0 (not yet passed) | yes |
| March 1 | March 31 | April 30 | 30 | yes |
| March 1 | March 31 | May 1 | 31 | no |

**Worked example (all inputs hypothetical)**

Billed for the turn-in: disposition fee $395.00, excess wear charge $1450.00, excess mileage charge $310.00 — $2155.00 in all. Security deposit applied $500.00; no end-of-term payment. A wear forgiveness waiver of $250.00 has posted.

- Plan balance: $2155.00 less $500.00, that is $1655.00; the $250.00 waiver is not taken off at enrollment.
- First installment: $1655.00 divided by 2 is $827.50; plus $35.00 is $862.50.
